title: Correctness of the borrow computation
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $p$ be one of its allowed input-head positions, and let $u$ be a finite Boolean word. If $b$ is the length of the initial segment of $u$ consisting of false entries, then $2b+2\le 2|u|+2$. Moreover, the one-tape debit machine, started in its initial search state with its head at cell zero and the tape containing $u$, reaches after $2b+2$ steps the configuration with its result state equal to the Boolean outcome of the borrow operation on $u$, its head at cell zero, and its tape containing the resulting word.
